class CompleteAtomicBooleanAlgebra (α : Type u) extends CompleteBooleanAlgebra α where
  protected iInf_iSup_eq {ι : Type u} {κ : ι → Type u} (f : ∀ a, κ a → α) :
    (⨅ a, ⨆ b, f a b) = ⨆ g : ∀ a, κ a, ⨅ a, f a (g a)
